createSubdomain.entranceAll: All (default) — all users can access, no restrictions
createSubdomain.entranceAppOnly: APP only — domain accessible only via APP, not web
createSubdomain.entranceH5Pwa: H5 & PWA — only H5 and PWA access, not in rotation list
createSubdomain.entranceCdnList: Aliyun, Funnull, Cloudflare (CF), Yundun, Wangsu-CDN, Tencent Cloud, AWS
createSubdomain.deviceNone: Block none (default) — all devices can access
createSubdomain.deviceBlockMobile: Block mobile — PC accessible, mobile (Android/iOS) blocked
createSubdomain.deviceBlockPc: Block PC — mobile (Android/iOS) accessible, PC blocked
createSubdomain.tip1: Configure 3+ nodes! Each node is a different CDN vendor. Multiple nodes enable auto-rotation, anti-blocking, and independent attack resistance. Each use case needs 3+ CDN vendors, especially Web Lobby, APP Lobby, OSS acceleration, and backend acceleration.
createSubdomain.tip2: Domains need regular network quality checks. For same CDN and use case, 3-10 subdomains is enough — not more, to avoid wasting detection time.
createSubdomain.tip3: Disabled domains are not resolved and won't be scanned externally. Add standby domains without enabling for quick future activation.
createSubdomain.tip4: Main domain must be added to CDN vendor first with DNS active before creating records. Subdomains are the actual use — add subdomains on each feature page after adding main domain.
createSubdomain.tip5: If main domain is blocked, subdomains are affected too. Add only 1-2 subdomains per main domain per use case.
createSubdomain.tip6: Due to firewall rules, use longer complex subdomains. Default www and @ short domains can be used for URL redirects.

tracking.title: Third-Party Tracking
tracking.description: Manage Web/App tracking and third-party analytics integration
tracking.notice1: Third-party tracking (Google / Facebook/Meta / TikTok / Kwai) uses Pixel integration; some loss is normal.
tracking.notice2: Deposit events rely on WebSocket push. If the app is backgrounded, offline, or closed, deposit events may not report in time.
tracking.notice3: Ad platforms use attribution rules. Conversions not attributed via ads usually won't appear in ad dashboards.
tracking.notice4: Tracking is for ad optimization only, not for financial settlement.
tracking.appTip: Tracking config has latency. APP tracking requires repackaging and is affected by release cycles and device state.
